run_dreambooth_lora_sdxl_training: run dreambooth LoRA training on SDXL with scheduled huber loss and configurable loss types
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset that loads and preprocesses instance and class images for SDXL fine-tuning
compute_conditional_loss: compute conditional loss with l2, huber, or smooth_l1 support and optional timestep-based weighting
log_validation_images: log validation images generated from a StableDiffusionXLPipeline to tensorboard or wandb
save_model_card: save a HuggingFace model card README with gallery, license, and download links for a trained LoRA
